title: Bott-periodicity prediction test for D_Omega dips
verdict: The Bott-periodicity hypothesis (D_Omega oscillates with log_2(N) mod 8) has Pearson r=+0.818 on the 8-data-point ladder. This is statistically marginal (uncorrected p~0.045, Bonferroni-corrected p~0.315 for 7 period hypotheses tested). Two specific data points DO match the Bott prediction cleanly: N=128 (log2=7, predicted deepest dip) and N=300 (log2=8.23, predicted rebound to vacuum 67/80, matched to 1.5%). The remaining 6 data points have residuals not captured by log2(N) mod 8 alone. The hypothesis is a STRUCTURAL CANDIDATE that requires multi-N runs at N=256, 512, 32768 to falsify or confirm. Falsifiable predictions: N=256 should give D_Omega near vacuum 67/80; N=32768 should give a second deep dip; N=65536 should give a second rebound. With current 8-point data, the hypothesis is consistent but not yet conclusively established.
